title: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon and Herbs
description: A simple and flavorful keto seafood dish, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper
Dredge the cod fillets in the mild all-purpose flour
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat
Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through
Remove the skillet from the oven and top each cod fillet with a pat of butter, a sprinkle of parsley and dill, and a squeeze of lemon juice
